name: SEO Content Proposals
description: Built-in default for the SEO content slot: one step that proposes content briefs for pages or keywords, then waits for approval.

steps.instructions: Write a short content brief or draft outline for each page listed in this run, to improve how it serves its search queries. Propose only; change nothing. Do not commit, push or open a pull request: this Building has no repository, and the website must never be edited. Do not browse the web unless the task says so. Finish by completing the step with one output named "proposals", format markdown, whose content is only a JSON object like {"pages":[{"url":"exact page address","title":"suggested heading","meta":"","notes":"the brief"}]}. Include only pages from the list.
steps.name: Propose content
